name: Movers and relocation companies

problems.words: Lots of enquiries on WhatsApp but most just want a price and disappear
quick_ideas: Ask every enquiry for move type, size and date first, so serious ones stand out
Offer a quick video survey slot, so real customers move forward.

workzap_build.text: WhatsApp enquiry intake that collects move details and photos and routes serious enquiries to the surveyor quickly.

problems.free_stops: The intake questions and routing are designed in the solution document.

problems.words: We reply late to enquiries and lose them
quick_ideas: Make one person responsible for enquiries during busy hours, so replies are fast
Look at last week's lost enquiries, so you see how long replies took.

workzap_build.text: Every enquiry recorded with follow-up reminders until it's booked or closed.

problems.free_stops: Follow-up timing is set in the solution document.

problems.words: Quotes based on photos are wrong and we lose money on the day
quick_ideas: Compare your last few quotes with actual volume, so you see how far off they run
Make quotes state clearly what's included.

workzap_build.text: A survey checklist and volume calculator by room that produces a standard quote.

problems.free_stops: The survey method and calculator are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Customers add items on moving day and argue about extra charges
quick_ideas: Get added items approved by the customer before loading, so there's no argument later
Tell customers at booking how extras are handled.

workzap_build.text: A move-day change form where added items are priced and approved by the customer on WhatsApp before loading.

problems.free_stops: The change-approval flow is designed in the solution document.

problems.words: Breakages lead to angry calls and bad Google reviews
quick_ideas: Photograph valuable furniture's condition before the move with the customer present, so damage claims start from facts
Reply calmly to recent reviews.

workzap_build.text: Pre- and post-move condition photos per job, and review requests sent automatically to genuinely happy customers.

problems.free_stops: The photo routine and review flow are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Two jobs booked on the same day with the same truck
quick_ideas: Keep one calendar of jobs with crew and truck assigned, so clashes are visible
Let one person book jobs.

workzap_build.text: A job calendar with crew, truck and helpers assigned, blocking double bookings and confirming helpers the night before.

problems.free_stops: The scheduling rules are set in the solution document.

problems.words: We don't know profit per job after labour, truck and material
quick_ideas: Work out the real cost of last week's jobs, so you see which types pay
Note packing material used per job.

workzap_build.text: Job costing with labour hours, truck and materials used vs quoted, per job.

problems.free_stops: How costs are captured per job is designed in the solution document.

problems.words: Crew leaders collect cash on site and it doesn't all reach us
quick_ideas: Offer customers a payment link, so less cash is handled on site
Settle on-site cash the same day, so gaps are caught.

workzap_build.text: Payment status per job with on-site cash logged and matched daily.

problems.free_stops: The settlement steps are in the solution document.

problems.words: We don't know which channel brings the good customers
quick_ideas: Ask every enquiry how they found you, so you can compare channels
Note which channels turned into paying jobs last month.

workzap_build.text: Links and codes per channel showing which ads and listings bring paying jobs.

problems.free_stops: How codes are set per channel is in the solution document.

problems.words: No repeat or referral system even though people move again
quick_ideas: Ask recent customers, with their permission, whether you may contact them later
List past corporate HR contacts you could reconnect with.

workzap_build.text: Follow-up messages to past customers who agreed, with referral reminders at the right time.

problems.free_stops: Message timing and content are planned in the solution document.

never_say: Anything on international household goods customs rules, duty-free allowances or prohibited items; suggest the destination agent or customs authority. Help hiding items in a shipment or under-declaring. Insurance claim outcomes or consumer law; customers' immigration or residency questions. Covert monitoring of crew accused of theft. Storing customers' addresses, numbers, ID copies or inventories of valuables. For lifting injuries, falls or truck accidents, emergency services come first.

sample_reply.person: We're movers in Dubai. We quote from photos, then on the day there's way more stuff and the customer won't pay extra. How do we fix this?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, this can be fixed, and you can start this week. 1. Compare your last few quotes against the real volume moved, so you see how far off the photo method runs. 2. Get any added items approved by the customer before loading, so the extra is agreed, not argued. Workzap can do this automatically for you: a room-by-room survey calculator for quotes and a move-day change form the customer approves on WhatsApp. Shall I have a solution document and quote prepared for you? You're welcome to say no.
